name: IGDB Source
description: Live catalog data source: resolves scanned games to canonical IGDB titles + cover/backdrop artwork via the IGDB v4 API (needs Twitch client id + secret), cached locally
author: Otix

igdb_client_id.label: IGDB Twitch Client ID
igdb_client_id.description: Twitch application Client ID used to authenticate against the IGDB API

igdb_client_secret.label: IGDB Twitch Client Secret
igdb_client_secret.description: Twitch application Client Secret used to authenticate against the IGDB API

indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_igdb_cache_title ON igdb_cache (title)
